title: CoreGuard Assurance Finding (cg41-finding/1)
description: One structured evidence finding per check. Normative per COREGUARD-ASSURANCE-SPEC v1 section 3.

id.description: Stable finding identifier, e.g. ENV-003, META-001, NEG-INT-01.

status.description: Closed status vocabulary. SKIPPED/OK/WARN are forbidden (spec section 3.2).

description.description: Human-readable statement of the check. Must obey spec section 4 wording rules.

failClosed.description: When true, any non-PASS status blocks forward transition and forces exit code 1.

evidence.description: Machine-recomputable proof supporting the status. Never empty; at least a reason or measured value.
